rows.sentence: The document requires closure at Saturday midnight:
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: Section 3-5 requires the bottle clubs identified in the next bullet to close at midnight on Saturday.

rows.sentence: - Closing hours: "All bottle clubs located in the unincorporated areas of the county, shall remain closed from the hours of 3:00 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. on each day of the week except that all such bottle clubs shall remain closed from midnight on each Saturday until 7:00 a.m. on the following Monday."
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The quotation reproduces both the ordinary closure hours and the weekend exception in section 3-5.

rows.sentence: - Scope: "the unincorporated areas of the county and any municipality which has not adopted an ordinance".
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The quotation identifies areas covered by the chapter, though it stops before specifying that the municipal ordinance must cover the regulated subject matter, activity, or conduct.

rows.sentence: - Bottle club: a place where products are sold "with the knowledge... that same will be... mixed... with... an alcoholic beverage".
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The definition includes selling a product with knowledge that it will be mixed with alcohol. The bullet gives only part of the definition.

rows.sentence: - General on-premises hours: "between the hours of 7:00 a.m. and 2:00 a.m. on all days of the week except Sunday"; Sunday "between the hours of 11:00 a.m. Sunday and 2:00 a.m. of the following day".
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: Section 3-3 gives both quoted time windows as the general on-premises hours for licensed establishments, subject to Sunday exceptions.

rows.sentence: - Violation: "a misdemeanor of the second degree".
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: Section 3-1 explicitly classifies a violation of the chapter as a second-degree misdemeanor.
